description: This file defines an abstract class AbstractCryptoClient for cryptographic operations within the AWS SDK for PHP. It details supported cipher types, key wrapping, and abstract methods for encryption and decryption streams, serving as a base for specific cryptographic client implementations.

classes.name: AbstractCryptoClient
classes.description: An abstract class providing cryptographic functionalities such as support checks, cipher handling, and stream encryption/decryption for AWS SDK PHP.

methods.name: isSupportedCipher
methods.description: Checks if a specified cipher name is supported by the SDK.

methods.name: getCipherOpenSslName
methods.description: Abstract method to get the OpenSSL cipher name based on cipher name and key size.

methods.name: buildCipherMethod
methods.description: Abstract method to construct a CipherMethod object for encryption/decryption.

methods.name: getCipherFromAesName
methods.description: Abstract method to reverse-lookup the OpenSSL cipher name from an AES name.

methods.name: encrypt
methods.description: Abstract method to create an encryption stream given plaintext, cipher options, provider, and metadata.

methods.name: decrypt
methods.description: Abstract method to create a decryption stream given ciphertext, provider, metadata, and options.
